result_text:
Tickets now record the support agent they're assigned to, and the agent comes back with the ticket in every listing and lookup you named. The full offline suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes, including a new test.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `support_agent VARCHAR(100)` column on `support_ticket`.
- **`model/SupportTicket.java`**: new `supportAgent` component (null = unassigned). I kept the old 9-argument constructor as a convenience so existing callers and tests compile unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the agent, and every ticket SELECT reads it, so the agent appears in all the listings and in the lookup by number. The status-update query only touches status and closed date, so the agent survives in-progress and closing.
- **`service/SupportTicketService.java`**: `create(...)` gained an overload taking the agent (blank is stored as unassigned). The original 6-argument `create` delegates with no agent. `changeStatus` carries the agent into the returned ticket.
- **`SupportTicketTest.java`**: new test covering assignment, trimming, an unassigned ticket, and the agent persisting through in-progress and closed.

I chose a free-text agent name rather than a new support-agent table, since the repo has no agent entity. If agents need their own records, that's a follow-up. Nothing was committed.
